name: Mira
description: Mira's presence schedule - performing, fixing, shadowing, and definitely not lurking near the castle

default.activity: leaning against something, watching the room
default.return_message: *steps out of a shadow she definitely wasn't hiding in* ...What? I was here the whole time.

default_return_message: *appears from somewhere* Don't look so surprised. I'm always around.
manual_away_message: *checks her daggers, adjusts her earring* Got something to handle. Try not to get into trouble without me. *pause* Actually, go ahead. I'll hear about it.

entries.away_message: *yawns, flips a dagger into its sheath* Alright. Even I need sleep. The exits are covered. Probably. *heads toward her loft*
*pulls on her jacket* Morning rounds. Markets, docks, the usual. If anyone asks, I was never here. *slips out*

entries.activity: near the castle grounds, probably sharpening something
